response.justification: Bogdan has extensive experience in software development, leadership roles, and open-source contributions, aligning well with the technical and strategic aspects of the role. However, his German proficiency is only basic (vs. required C1), and his background leans more toward software engineering than IT architecture or team management at an executive level. His UML expertise is not explicitly mentioned, which is a key requirement.
strengths: Strong open-source contributions and leadership in projects like GISCollective and Fluent-Asserts
Diverse technical expertise across multiple languages, frameworks, and domains (e.g., Node.js, DLang, Python)
Proven ability to mentor teams and implement best practices (e.g., TDD, CI/CD) in high-performance environments
concerns: German language proficiency is only basic, falling short of the required C1 level
Lacks explicit mention of UML expertise or complex IT system design experience
Limited evidence of high-level IT architecture or strategic project oversight at an executive scale
